title: Feline Warfare
description: A Minecraft mod inspired by The Battle Cats. Introducing new weapons, enchantments, mechanics and more much in the future.
body:
![logo](https://i.imgur.com/PJmd5Ns.png)

**Feline Warfare** is a Minecraft Forge mod for 1.20.1 inspired by _The Battle Cats_. It introduces new weapons, materials, enchantments, and combat mechanics drawn from the Battle Cats universe.

Requires **GeckoLib 4.2+**

# **Weapons**

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

Scourge's Staff: Conjures a Surge that pushes enemies away with powerful horizontal knockback. Built for crowd control.

![scourge staff](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cf11b4a3836df3ef2ae0b334159024a77a1e7d9f.png)

Bane's Staff: Conjures a stronger Surge that inflicts Curse on enemies, stripping them of their enchantments and preventing them from applying debuffs to you.

![bane staff](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/78be6cd003075a76b2ec4d69b21ce912dc088e47.png)

</details>

# **Effects**


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

The Curse System

Enemies hit by the Bane's Surge are inflicted with Curse, a custom debuff that:

- Disables all enchantments on the cursed entity (no Protection, no Thorns, no Fire Aspect).
- Blocks harmful effects from reaching you (a cursed Husk can't inflict Hunger, a cursed Stray can't apply Slowness, a cursed Cave Spider can't poison you).
- Works generically against any mob, including modded ones.

![curse effect](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/eaee090023afceb836e2f1a9b6216f3952a700d2.png)

Surge:
a towering AoE column of energy that damages and affects all enemies caught within it.

- Surge levels determine how long it does last (ex. level 1 last 1s, level 2 lasts 2s and etc.)
- Bypass armor due being magical damage

![surge blast](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d31485bc36982d195949d218eeb8052bfd1a6a51.png)

</details>

# **Progression**

Currently a full crafting chain tied to the Nether. Mine rare soul-infused ores, refine them into crafting components, and forge new weapons. Though may suffer alteration in later updates.

Currently 3 advancements + a secret one.

![advancements](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/04c399f9c12fa8b3d1720b6b5066cac70dab81a8.png)
